theorem_title: The extended counting domain is exactly 1 through 734
natural_language_statement:
Let $D$ be the source list formed by concatenating the complement of $G=\{122,183,244,366,732\}$ in $\{1,\ldots,732\}$, the list of elements of $G$, and $[733,734]$. For every $x\in\mathbb N$,

$$
x\in D\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad 0<x\leq734.
$$

This support lemma identifies the explicit list used by the finite cardinality function with the intended interval.
